products.name: Braintrust
products.note: Evaluation-first LLM platform; datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, prompt iteration with production trace feedback

profile_text.body:
Braintrust is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2022 that describes itself as an active observability platform for AI agents. Its platform is designed to help development teams trace production behavior, run evaluations, catch regressions before they reach users, and iterate on prompts using feedback from production traces. The company positions its tooling around the idea that AI models drift and regress silently, and it surfaces patterns automatically to help teams evaluate against expectations on a continuous basis.

The core product, also called Braintrust, falls in the AI governance and risk management category and centers on an evaluation-first approach to large language model development. It includes datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, and prompt iteration workflows. The platform also features a component called Loop, which the company describes as generating improved prompts, scorers, and datasets automatically based on a user-specified optimization goal. Braintrust additionally offers an MCP server that connects a coding agent to a user's AI stack, allowing logs to be queried, evaluations to be run, and prompts to be updated directly from an IDE.

The site's held facts note 161 legal exposure records associated with California, though no specific cases are on file. The company maintains a verified presence in the site's registry as of August 2026.
